title: Virtual Card Management: Setting Up Team Spending Caps and Limits
summary: Explains how to use Virtual Card Management to set per-card spending limits ($55–$30,000) and team-wide spending caps (via Team settings > Spending controls), including choosing reset periods (per transaction, daily, or monthly) and saving changes. Also covers restricting merchant categories and periodically reviewing/adjusting limits.
faqs: How do I set a per-card spending limit for a virtual card, and what range is allowed?
Where do I configure team-wide spending caps, and what reset periods can I use?
Can I restrict spending by merchant categories, and how is that applied (card vs. team policy)?
What steps are involved in saving a limit or cap after selecting the reset period?
What guidance does the document give for choosing initial limits and later adjusting them?
Do team spending caps and merchant-category restrictions need to be checked for availability first?
